Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Can you play a Rebirth to avoid the blood hunt after playing an
Abactor?

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 23 July 2009 20:53:42 -0700 (PDT), XZealot wrote:

>Can you play a Rebirth to avoid the blood hunt after playing an
>Abactor?

No.

Abactor is not an action to commit diablerie.

Abactor [Promo-20090401]
Cardtype: Action
+1 stealth hunt action.
Gain 5 blood. After successful resolution, a referendum is called to
call a blood hunt on this vampire (independent of the action, just as
if he or she had committed diablerie).
Artist: Juan Calle

Rebirth [KMW:R/PAn]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Requires a Red List minion. Only usable when a diablerie action is
successful.
No blood hunt may be called, and this vampire untaps. A vampire can
play only one Rebirth each turn.
Artist: Brian Miskelley

Carpe noctem.
